audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Levels 1-2 to Malphite and Levels 3 and 4-5 to 'Skill', while every whys[] entry says Mundo owns the lane from level 1 ('Malphite's poke and armor do nothing to your health-stacking at level 1 while you out-trade').
audit.why: Packet chart is Dr. Mundo for Level 1 through Level 6 and Skill at 2+ items; the win rate is 56.58% over 3906 games. The mirror side (malphite__drmundo) reads 47.73% for Malphite, so both directions agree Mundo wins lane and it only levels out late.
audit.corrected: Dr. Mundo for Levels 1 through 6, Skill at 2+ items — ratings 7/7/7/7/7/7/5, with the Level 1 and 2 why-text rewritten (they had been telling you Level 1 was your worst level in the game).

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes cited no cooldowns and never mentioned Granite Shield, the thing that actually gates his trading.
audit.why: Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of Malphite's max health and only recharges if he has NOT been hit for a few seconds. Infected Bonesaw is a flat 4s cooldown at 975 range — poking on cooldown means the shield never comes back.
audit.corrected: The Level 1-5 spike now states the 4s Q keeps Granite Shield permanently broken, and the mana cost (70 at rank 1, 8s cooldown) that makes him answer it badly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thunderclap is called Malphite's Q in three places (spikes[0].text, early, wants.foe[0]). Thunderclap is his W; his Q is Seismic Shard. 'Spirit Visor' is not an item. Granite Shield and the Thunderclap auto-reset never appear anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's data: Q Seismic Shard (625 range, 8s, steals move speed), W Thunderclap (auto-attack reset, aftershocks that apply on-hit), E Ground Slam (7s, magic damage scaling off his ARMOUR, reduces your attack speed), R Unstoppable Force (130/115/100s). Mundo's Q out-ranges Seismic Shard 975 to 625.
audit.corrected: Rename Thunderclap to W and Seismic Shard to Q, add the 975-vs-625 range edge, name Granite Shield as the thing your 4s Q suppresses, flag Thunderclap's wind-up as the step-back cue, and fix Spirit Visage.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'His Ground Slam' in mid — Ground Slam is the real E name, so it is a false positive and mid keeps it.

edits.before: Malphite is a passive farmer who leans on Thunderclap (Q) poke and his Ground Slam (E) armor-shred for waveclear, but none of that dents a health-stacking Mundo. Your Q Infected Bonesaw slows him from range and your E Blunt Force Trauma gives you a big auto that out-trades his mana-hungry poke. Hard-shove and deny him a comfortable farm.
edits.after: Malphite is a passive farmer leaning on Seismic Shard (Q) poke and Ground Slam (E) waveclear, and none of it dents a health-stacking Mundo. Infected Bonesaw out-ranges his Q 975 to 625, and on a flat 4s cooldown it keeps Granite Shield — 10% of his max health — broken permanently. Hard-shove and deny him a comfortable farm.

edits.before: Lane's even-ish only because Malphite's whole game is his R engage in teamfights, not the 1v1 — build MR (Spirit Visor) and even his ult-into-full-combo can't kill you. Track his flank, don't get caught alone by a Flash-R, and otherwise you out-scale him as the deeper, more self-sufficient frontline.

notes: Chart flipped to the packet and to its own whys: Dr. Mundo owns Levels 1-6, it evens to Skill at 2+ items. The Level 1 and Level 2 why-text had been boilerplate telling the player this was his worst level in the game, in a lane he wins 56.58% of — both rewritten. Real name error killed in three places: Thunderclap was written as Malphite's Q; it is his W, and Seismic Shard is the Q. Fixed 'Spirit Visor' to Spirit Visage. The decisive interaction now stated: Granite Shield absorbs 10% of his max health and only recharges after a few seconds unhit, so Infected Bonesaw's flat 4s cooldown keeps it permanently down — and your Q out-ranges his 975 to 625. Consistent with the mirror (malphite__drmundo), which reads 47.73% for Malphite. QUESTION FOR THE USER, text left alone: does Dr. Mundo's passive consume on Unstoppable Force's knock-up? Riot calls the passive a resist of the first 'Immobilizing effect' and does not say whether an airborne knock-up counts; several fields would change if it does, so I asserted nothing either way. Also noted by the mirror and re-confirmed here: the kit file's 'grounding' flags on Seismic Shard and Ground Slam contradict Riot's descriptions (move-speed steal and attack-speed reduction only) — no grounding claim written.
